title: Public Health Provides Guidance and Recommendations Ahead of  FIFA World Cup
description:
As Los Angeles prepares to host the 2026 FIFA World Cup, the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health will host a media briefing along with Los Angeles County Supervisor Holly J. Mitchell, the Los Angeles County Fire Department, the Los Angeles County Emergency Medical Services Agency, and the Los Angeles County Department of Parks and Recreation to remind residents and visitors to stay safe by taking common-sense steps to avoid health risks. 

The briefing will also highlight Public Health's "Winning Starts With" campaign and website, which provide practical guidance and resources on heat safety, hydration, overdose prevention, and emergency preparedness so fans can celebrate safely during one of the world's largest sporting events.
